answers.goal: My goal is to be a self-sustaining Music Composer for film and video games. I want to be a part of projects that leave the audience with a new perspective on life.  I also release my own instrumental music on the side, so I hope to pursue content creation in hopes of sharing my music to the world. I want to make a lasting impact and create music that sticks with people.
answers.drew: I love being around like-minded individuals because being in such a vibrant environment inspires me to create. I am drawn to the passion that is put into every project and how many unique perspectives I encounter.
answers.seeking: I am looking to connect with individuals of all kinds of creative backgrounds. Whether that be producers, directors, or other composers, I want to find people that are highly ambitious and are in the same industry so we can support each others work. Most importantly, I want to make lasting friendships because I am not from LA and secondly, I would like to meet people I can work with in the future.
answers.inspiration: My biggest inspiration is Kensuke Ushio, a film and anime composer from Japan. He inspires me because he was one of the first anime composers to branch out into his own niche. During a time where orchestral music dominated, he brought a lot of unconventional electronic production into his scores which eventually influenced the sound palette of future anime scores. Seeing him embrace his unique artistry makes me want to experiment a lot more and find my own authentic voice in this industry.
